title: The SOX9 C-terminus encodes a transferable cBAF-recruitment module for enhancer remodeling and cell-state control.
authors: Raghawan, Akhouri K; Li, Zhixin; Wang, Xiaolu; Huang, Yingbo; Doan, Paul; Gudipudi, Anoushka C; Conway, Caroline; Kositbovornchai, Supakrit; Hsiang, Evan; Lie, Pearl Y P; Cleary, James M; Sethi, Nilay S
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SOX9转录因子C端无序区招募cBAF染色质重塑复合物以调控增强子可及性，虽涉及TF-DNA结合与染色质开放，但核心是染色质重塑而非TF-DNA互作建模，且方法为实验生物学，无AI或物理模拟，故仅部分相关。
abstract: Transcription factors select genomic targets, but how they recruit chromatin remodelers to convert DNA occupancy into cell-state-specific accessibility remains unclear. Here, we identify an intrinsically disordered SOX9 C-terminal module that recruits SMARCB1-containing canonical BAF (cBAF) to stem-like enhancers that open during APC -mutant adenoma formation. Acute, reversible SOX9 degradation displaces cBAF from  approximately 80% of co-bound enhancers, exceeding effects on pBAF and ncBAF, and collapses accessibility and stem-like identity; SOX9 re-expression restores these features. C-terminal truncation preserves DNA binding but disrupts cBAF engagement and chromatin opening. Enforced SMARCB1 docking to truncated SOX9 partially restores cBAF recruitment, accessibility, stem-like transcription, and organoid self-renewal, identifying remodeler recruitment as a limiting effector function. The isolated C-terminus supports higher-order cBAF assembly and, when fused to dCas9 as COMET, redirects endogenous cBAF to targeted loci to open chromatin. Disordered TF regions can therefore encode transferable instructions that deploy specific remodeling complexes to control cell state. HIGHLIGHTS: The SOX9 C-terminal IDR recruits cBAF to adenoma-emergent enhancersSMARCB1 is required for SOX9-dependent enhancer accessibility and stem identity Forced SMARCB1 docking restores stem-like enhancer state and self-renewal to SOX9 (DeltaC) The isolated SOX9 module is sufficient to open chromatin via endogenous cBAF.
abstract_zh: 转录因子选择基因组靶点，但它们如何招募染色质重塑复合物，将DNA占据转化为细胞状态特异性的可及性，仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了一个内在无序的SOX9 C端模块，该模块将含SMARCB1的经典BAF（cBAF）招募至在APC突变腺瘤形成过程中开放的干样增强子。急性、可逆的SOX9降解使cBAF从约80%的共结合增强子上脱离，其效应超过对pBAF和ncBAF的影响，并导致可及性和干样特性崩溃；SOX9重新表达可恢复这些特征。C端截短保留了DNA结合，但破坏了cBAF的参与和染色质开放。将SMARCB1强制对接至截短的SOX9上，部分恢复了cBAF招募、可及性、干样转录和类器官自我更新，从而将重塑复合物招募确定为限制性效应功能。分离的C端支持高阶cBAF组装，当作为COMET融合至dCas9时，可将内源性cBAF重定向至靶向位点以开放染色质。因此，无序转录因子区域可编码可转移的指令，部署特定重塑复合物以控制细胞状态。亮点：SOX9 C端内在无序区（IDR）将cBAF招募至腺瘤新生增强子；SMARCB1是SOX9依赖性增强子可及性和干样特性所必需的；强制SMARCB1对接可恢复SOX9（ΔC）的干样增强子状态和自我更新；分离的SOX9模块足以通过内源性cBAF开放染色质。
